security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: gnomon desktop opens the read-only gnomon dashboard for a project folder in its own window. It runs the gnomon CLI already installed on this machine, serves nothing beyond 127.0.0.1, sends no telemetry and does not update itself.
